mapper.sql: workspace_id, tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, session_id, product_session_id, end_user_id, cleanup_state, initial_operation_id, initialized
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_chat_session_workspaces(workspace_id,tenant_id,session_id,product_session_id,end_user_id,cleanup_state,initial_operation_id,initialized) SELECT #{workspaceId},CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint),#{sessionId},#{productSessionId},#{endUserId},'active',#{initialOperationId},FALSE WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_sessions WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{productSessionId} AND end_user_id=#{endUserId} AND NOT jsonb_exists_any(COALESCE(metadata,'{}'::jsonb),ARRAY['closed_at','open_platform_closed_at'])) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,session_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_chat_session_workspaces WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session}
SELECT FROM nw_chat_session_workspaces WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND product_session_id=#{productSession} AND cleanup_state='active' ORDER BY session_id

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_sessions WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{productSession} AND end_user_id=#{endUser} AND NOT jsonb_exists_any(COALESCE(metadata,'{}'::jsonb),ARRAY['closed_at','open_platform_closed_at']))
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_chat_session_workspaces w SET cleanup_state='pending',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE w.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND w.cleanup_state='active' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_sessions s WHERE s.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND s.session_id=w.product_session_id AND s.end_user_id=w.end_user_id AND NOT jsonb_exists_any(COALESCE(s.metadata,'{}'::jsonb),ARRAY['closed_at','open_platform_closed_at']))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_chat_session_workspaces WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND cleanup_state='pending' ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_chat_session_workspaces SET cleanup_state='complete',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND workspace_id=#{workspace} AND cleanup_state='pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_chat_session_workspace_imports(tenant_id,workspace_id,operation_id,evidence) VALUES(CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{workspace},#{operation},CAST(#{evidence} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,workspace_id,operation_id) DO NOTHING
